groups.title: Relational nounstems and contextual function
groups.proposal: Treat relational forms as typed NNC nounstems whose contextual translations do not supply morphological Source slots.
groups.readingJob: Show relational identity, participant role, locale, Source, goal, path, and contextual translation separately.
groups.decisionSplit: Only typed Source and participant facts enter grammar; translations remain descriptive.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not install a preposition category or infer morphology from English glosses.

groups.title: Four relational usage options
groups.proposal: Represent simple possessive, integrated matrix, connective-t linked, and compound-embed uses as licensed typed formations rather than surface rewrites.
groups.readingJob: Show Source mode, embedded material, matrix, connective boundary, state, and subject branch.
groups.decisionSplit: Expose only the options licensed by the selected relational stem family.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not offer all four options to every relational stem.

groups.title: Five option-license groups
groups.proposal: Derive each relational stem's available formation set from one of five canonical option groups.
groups.readingJob: Show the selected stem family, option group, allowed formations, and rejected alternatives.
groups.decisionSplit: A formation is selectable only when the stem's option group licenses it.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer option availability from a similar surface or translation.

groups.title: Option-one-only relational stems
groups.proposal: Realize huān, tloc, pal, and c/ic through their licensed possessive Source, including reciprocal downgrade, affective formation, and fixed possessor restrictions.
groups.readingJob: Show possessor, relational matrix, state, reciprocal analysis, affective availability, and lexical restrictions.
groups.decisionSplit: Possessor is a genuine choice except where the owner fixes it.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not expose integrated-matrix or linked options for option-one-only stems.

groups.title: c/ic means, purpose, reason, and time
groups.proposal: Keep the fixed third-common possessor and let typed context distinguish means, purpose, reason, and time without multiplying homonymous engines.
groups.readingJob: Show fixed possessor, shared relational identity, contextual function, and unchanged morphological ownership.
groups.decisionSplit: Contextual function may be selected only within the licensed c/ic function inventory.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not let the contextual reading replace the typed relational Source.

groups.title: ic clause position, interrogation, and negation
groups.proposal: Compose initial interrogative, noninitial noninterrogative, fused in, and negative uses through typed clause context while preserving the same relational owner.
groups.readingJob: Show position, interrogative force, negation, adjunct presence, fusion, and the resulting contextual restriction.
groups.decisionSplit: Only context combinations licensed by the owner are selectable.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize a use from word order or punctuation alone.

groups.title: ic ordinal, adverbial, degree, and measurement uses
groups.proposal: Project ordinal, adverbial, degree, and measurement readings from the shared typed c/ic Source and exact modifiers.
groups.readingJob: Show source identity, modifier type, special-use taxonomy, and contextual interpretation independently.
groups.decisionSplit: Modifier and use are genuine choices only when the selected Source licenses them.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not create separate grammar routes from translation labels.
